'''jedimaster My NEW CPI Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[jedimaster]]
* '''Published:''' 21 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''Strategy:''' Set Your Course For Alderaan
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed SYCFA jedimaster DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

This is my NEW CPI deck. Lemme know what you guys think. Here is some info..

VCSD will be replaced by unique SD ASAP.

Need a better starting card than Mob. Points, any suggestions?

What about the location choices?

The deck requires very little in the way of strategy. Just pull and play, should be able to take out Alderaan in about 5 or 6 turns. Then pull systems and drain like mad.

I was also thinking of taking out the HTLB dunno though. Any input welcome..ya guys haven't steered me wrong yet!! :)
